title: Bechtel, the firm building Micron’s factory, is holding a job fair soon
summary: Bechtel Corporation, the contractor building Micron Technology's semiconductor manufacturing facility in Clay, is hosting a job fair on October 21, 2026 in DeWitt. This represents workforce development activity related to the major economic development project bringing advanced chipmaking to the region.
